product_overview: CRM Next Gen is a Brazilian Portuguese B2B sales CRM for managing leads, accounts, deals, proposals, contracts, and post-sales operations. It helps sales teams track pipeline progress, generate commercial proposals, and manage customer relationships from first contact through signature.
core_goals: Authenticate into the CRM and access the main workspace
Manage leads, accounts, contacts, products, and deals across the sales pipeline
Create, edit, export, send, and track commercial proposals and contracts
Track activities, sales orders, purchases, reports, and sales performance
Configure goals, commissions, automations, integrations, and system settings

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to access the CRM using email/password or Office 365 login and then enter the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Choose Office 365 login -> Complete the sign-in process -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows an executive summary of sales metrics, charts, recent activity, and commission visibility controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review KPI cards -> Review the sales funnel chart -> Review recent activity feed
Navigate to /dashboard -> Toggle commission privacy -> Observe commission values blur or reveal
Navigate to /dashboard -> Change the date range -> Observe the dashboard metrics update

features.name: Pipeline Kanban Board
features.description: Lets users manage deals visually across pipeline stages and inspect deal details, health, and quotes.
user_flows: Navigate to /pipeline -> Review deals in the pipeline board -> Drag a deal to a different stage -> See the deal update in the new stage
Navigate to /pipeline -> Create a new deal -> Fill in deal details -> Save the deal -> See the deal appear on the board
Navigate to /pipeline -> Open a deal card -> Review deal details -> Edit the deal information -> Save changes
Navigate to /pipeline -> Apply filters by owner, value, or tags -> See the board update with matching deals

features.name: Lead Management
features.description: Supports capturing, qualifying, editing, converting, and removing sales leads.
user_flows: Navigate to /leads -> Create a new lead -> Fill in company, contact, and address information -> Save the lead -> See the lead in the list
Navigate to /leads -> Open a lead -> Update lead details -> Change the lead status -> Save changes -> See the updated status in the table
Navigate to /leads -> Select a qualified lead -> Convert the lead to a deal -> See the new deal created in the sales flow
Navigate to /leads -> Search or filter leads -> Review only the matching leads
Navigate to /leads -> Open a lead with incorrect data -> Delete the lead -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Account Management
features.description: Enables management of corporate customer accounts, including branches, contacts, tags, documents, and status.
user_flows: Navigate to /accounts -> Create a new account -> Fill in company and address details -> Save the account -> See it listed
Navigate to /accounts -> Open an account -> Review the information tabs -> Add or edit branches and contacts -> Save changes
Navigate to /accounts -> Open an account -> Upload a document -> See the document attached to the account
Navigate to /accounts -> Search or filter accounts -> Review the matching accounts
Navigate to /accounts -> Open an account -> Change the status or add tags -> Save changes -> See the updated account summary

features.name: Contact Management
features.description: Lets users manage people linked to corporate accounts, including phone numbers, roles, and primary contact status.
user_flows: Navigate to /contacts -> Create a new contact -> Enter name, email, phone, and role details -> Link the contact to an account -> Save the contact -> See it in the list
Navigate to /contacts -> Open a contact -> Edit the contact details -> Save changes -> See the updated contact record
Navigate to /contacts -> Open a contact -> Set the contact as primary for the account -> Save changes -> See the primary flag applied
Navigate to /contacts -> Upload a business card or signature image -> Parse the contact details -> Review the extracted information

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Provides product listing and maintenance for items used in sales quoting and proposal generation.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Create a new product -> Fill in name, SKU, category, brand, and margin -> Save the product -> See it in the catalog
Navigate to /products -> Search or filter products -> Review only the matching items
Navigate to /products -> Open a product -> Edit the product details -> Save changes -> See the updated product record
Navigate to /products -> Select a product that is no longer needed -> Delete the product -> See it removed from the catalog

features.name: Proposal Management
features.description: Supports creating, editing, exporting, sending, versioning, and tracking commercial proposals with product line items and signatures.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals -> Create a new proposal linked to a deal -> Open the full-screen proposal editor -> Add product line items -> Configure discounts, taxes, and terms -> Save the proposal
Navigate to /proposals -> Open an existing proposal -> Generate an AI summary -> Review the generated content -> Save the proposal
Navigate to /proposals -> Open a proposal -> Export it as PDF, DOCX, or PPTX -> Receive the generated file
Navigate to /proposals -> Open a proposal -> Send the proposal to the client -> See the status change to sent
Navigate to /portal -> Open the proposal through a public token -> Review the proposal details -> Accept or reject the proposal -> Provide a digital signature
Navigate to /proposals -> Open a proposal -> Review version history -> Select a previous version -> See the earlier content

features.name: Contract Management
features.description: Enables creation, review, sending, and signing of contracts linked to deals and proposals.
user_flows: Navigate to /contracts -> Create a new contract linked to a deal or proposal -> Fill in the contract details -> Save the contract -> See it in the list
Navigate to /contracts -> Open a contract -> Review the document preview -> Send the contract for signature -> See the status update
Navigate to /contracts -> Open a contract -> Capture a digital signature -> See the contract marked as signed
Navigate to /contracts -> Filter contracts by status -> Review the matching contracts

features.name: Activity Management
features.description: Helps users track tasks, meetings, calls, emails, and notes in list or calendar views with reminders and completion tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /activities -> Create a new activity -> Choose the activity type -> Set priority, assignee, and due date -> Save the activity -> See it in the list or calendar
Navigate to /activities -> Open an activity -> Add meeting details, outcome, and next steps -> Save changes -> See the updated activity record
Navigate to /activities -> Open an activity -> Mark it as completed -> See the activity move to completed status
Navigate to /activities -> Apply filters by type, status, priority, assignee, or date -> Review the matching activities
Navigate to /activities -> View AI-suggested activities -> Review the suggestions -> Save one as a new activity

features.name: Sales Orders
features.description: Allows users to create, view, search, and track sales orders and their fulfillment status.
user_flows: Navigate to /sales-orders -> Create a new sales order -> Enter order details and line items -> Save the order -> See it in the order list
Navigate to /sales-orders -> Open a sales order -> Review the line items and order details -> Track the order status
Navigate to /sales-orders -> Search or filter orders -> Review the matching orders

features.name: Purchases
features.description: Lets users manage purchase orders created for distributors and monitor order progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /purchases -> Create a purchase order for a distributor -> Enter the order details -> Save the order -> See it in the list
Navigate to /purchases -> Open a purchase order -> Review the order details -> Track the order status
Navigate to /purchases -> Search or filter purchase orders -> Review the matching orders

features.name: Price List Management
features.description: Supports managing pricing tables, distributor pricing, currency settings, and spreadsheet import/export.
user_flows: Navigate to /price-lists -> Create a new price list -> Enter the pricing details -> Save the price list -> See it in the list
Navigate to /price-lists -> Open a price list -> Update pricing and exchange rate settings -> Save changes -> See the updated values
Navigate to /price-lists -> Import prices from Excel -> Review the imported pricing data
Navigate to /price-lists -> Export prices to Excel -> Receive the exported spreadsheet

features.name: Goals and Commissions
features.description: Allows sales targets, quarterly distribution, commission rules, and financial scenario planning to be configured and reviewed.
user_flows: Navigate to /goals -> Select a seller -> Set yearly and monthly goals -> Configure quarterly distribution -> Save the goals -> See the progress configuration
Navigate to /goals -> Define commission rules by product category -> Save the rules -> See the updated commission setup
Navigate to /goals-commissions -> Create a financial scenario -> Enter costs, margins, and revenue assumptions -> Review the scenario results
Navigate to /goals -> Toggle commission privacy -> Observe commission values blur or reveal

features.name: Reports and Analytics
features.description: Provides sales, pipeline, revenue, and team performance reporting with date filtering and export options.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Review sales performance charts -> Review pipeline analytics -> Review team comparison metrics
Navigate to /reports -> Change the date range -> Observe the report charts update
Navigate to /reports -> Export report data -> Receive the exported file

features.name: Workflow Automations
features.description: Lets users build and manage rule-based automations using triggers, conditions, actions, and email templates.
user_flows: Navigate to /automations -> Create a new automation rule -> Choose a trigger -> Add conditions -> Configure actions -> Save the automation -> See it in the rules list
Navigate to /automations -> Open an automation rule -> Enable or disable it -> See the updated rule status
Navigate to /automations -> Open email templates -> Review or update a template -> Save changes -> See the updated template

features.name: Integrations and API
features.description: Provides management of third-party integrations, API keys, webhooks, and related audit history.
user_flows: Navigate to /integrations -> Review connected integrations -> Connect or disconnect an integration -> See the connection status change
Navigate to /integrations -> Generate a new API key -> Copy the key details -> See the key added to the list
Navigate to /integrations -> Create a webhook -> Configure the event subscriptions and URL -> Save the webhook -> See it listed as active
Navigate to /integrations -> Review audit logs -> Inspect recent integration activity

features.name: Settings
features.description: Lets administrators manage users, roles, permissions, pipeline stages, and organization settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Create a new user -> Assign a role -> Save the user -> See the user listed
Navigate to /settings -> Open a user record -> Edit roles or permissions -> Save changes -> See the updated access configuration
Navigate to /settings -> Deactivate a user -> Confirm the change -> See the user marked inactive
Navigate to /settings -> Configure pipeline stages -> Save the stage setup -> See the updated pipeline configuration
Navigate to /settings -> Update organization settings -> Save changes -> See the updated organization profile

known_limitations.issue: Email inbox requires Office 365 OAuth configuration with Azure AD
known_limitations.impact: Email features are non-functional without proper Azure AD app registration and Supabase provider configuration

known_limitations.issue: AI features require Google Gemini API key
known_limitations.impact: AI proposal generation and activity suggestions will fail without GEMINI_API_KEY in environment variables

known_limitations.issue: Application UI is entirely in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
known_limitations.impact: All labels, status values, and form fields use Portuguese language
